```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```
```{r}
Inverts_morro<-read.csv("McAbee Invertebrate Spreadsheet - Invertebrate Data (1).csv")
Inverts_mcabee<-read.csv("Morro Bay Invertebrate Spreadsheet - Sheet1 (1).csv")
```

```{r}
McAbee_density <- Inverts_mcabee %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(Density = sum(Total_Count, na.rm = TRUE) / 100)

ggplot(McAbee_density,
       aes(x = reorder(Species, -Density), y = Density,
       fill = Species)) +
  geom_col() +
labs(title = "Density of McAbee Invertebrate Species 2026",
    x = "Species", y = "Density per Meter Squared") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.35, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
```
